summary: Route primary workflow by explicit email Subject before explicit body heading before filename while retaining different exact identifiers as references.
decision_refs: Active user goal to continue improving accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and email content
Confirmed synthetic reproduction where a Submittal Subject email was mislabeled as RFI because its body referenced an RFI
approval_evidence: The active user goal explicitly includes continued RFI, Submittal and email accuracy improvements.
known_limitations: Precedence requires explicit supported workflow prefixes; semantic Subject or body inference is intentionally not performed.
If multiple explicit workflows occur at the same routing level, the existing conservative RFI-first tie-break remains.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no mailbox, model or external provider request is used.
